column1: # B7b-2 Phase C gate (Task 12): class rows for the B7b-2/C classes. An operand group (spec 6.1) is ONE
# preproc_conditional_operand whose every arm's operand is fielded `operand`; the placements whole-operand, unary-paren,
# unary-minus, unary-not and signed (`E op #if X F #else G #endif`, the arm F as written) and first-only (`#if X E #else
# F #endif`, the whole slot). "right operand of the binary before it": `left: (_) right: (group)`; "stands as one
# operand": the group is a child of whatever node static precedence nests it in (`3 + G * 2` puts it under the `*`),
# which the ladder fixtures (b7b2_ladder_matrix_test.txt, b7b2_ladder_positions_test.txt) pin and these rows do not
# (spec 3.2: a region is no grouping claim). The `first` rows (`#if X E op #endif F`, an operand prefix, spec 6.3) were
# widened from "between a binary's left and right" to "right before the operand it continues", which also covers the
# leading prefix of a region root (case pattern, property value, range left, until condition, ternary else, list
# element, split-call argument, the inside of a unary). Every row fails on al-main.so's tree by its pattern, not only by
# has_error (main has no preproc_conditional_operand, and gives no prefix at these slots), except the 23/8/8/22/8
# binary-operand/first members that main already parsed with the binary-internal prefix. A first-only group inside a
# preproc_conditional_arguments arm is an operand group (the four cell rows below), at the argument list itself the
# argument group (row P', the class row).
